flight.note: Round trip out of Boise (Gowen Field), returning to Boise. Filed speed 375 kts, filed altitude 28,000 ft, filed duration 5:07:00 (18420s), all confirmed directly from Alex's own FlightAware app. Filed route text: VALYY 4610N/11505W FCA100042/D1+30 MSO210060/D1+30 4603N/11342W 4539N/11312W 4420N/11408W. The dashed line below plots this route directly, fix by fix -- not FlightAware's own derived map line (which is a separate, algorithmically-simplified field that changed shape over the flight and doesn't correspond 1:1 to this text). VALYY (the first fix, in Idaho) is not plotted -- no reliable public coordinate source found for it after checking FAA, GlobalAir, AirNav, and FlightPlanDatabase (all blocked or empty); not guessed. The two D1+30 holds are plotted using real FCA/MSO VOR coordinates with a 13.5-degree magnetic-to-true correction applied to the published radials, and both land almost exactly on the real ADS-B loop centers recorded during the flight -- cross-validated against actual data, not blind computation.
flight.pattern: Real recorded track below is FlightAware's own track data for this flight (not airplanes.live/adsb.lol), auto-refreshed periodically by a scheduled re-pull, permanently baked into this file each cycle (not dependent on any browser tab staying open) -- 555 baked points, 18:12Z-22:25Z. **LANDED at KBOI (Boise/Gowen Field), confirmed by FlightAware (flightStatus: arrived, actual landing time 22:26Z, ~30 min ahead of the earlier estimate).** Full mission: departed KBOI ~17:52Z, surveyed the Silvertip/Kalispell-Flathead corridor, then central Idaho (Salmon-Challis NF), then the Bitterroot Valley (Butterfly and Black Bear fires), then the Doublesprings Fire area, then returned and landed at KBOI. Left active per standing instruction -- archiving is Alex's call, not automatic. Note: FlightAware's own plotted route-line waypoints changed as of the 20:45Z refresh (42->45 points, planned distance 694->810nm) -- the underlying filed route TEXT is unchanged (still VALYY 4610N/11505W FCA100042/D1+30 MSO210060/D1+30 4603N/11342W 4539N/11312W 4420N/11408W); still unconfirmed whether that's a genuine FAA amendment or FlightAware's own recalculation. Visible in the real recorded track: climbed out of Boise, flew many repeated north-south survey passes over the Missoula-to-Kalispell/Flathead corridor (Silvertip fire area), circled ~20:16Z-21:26Z over central Idaho (46.0-46.36N/-115.0 to -115.28W, Salmon-Challis NF), then flew directly east across the Bitterroot Range starting ~21:26Z, now over the Bitterroot Valley near 46.14N/-114.02W (21:36Z) -- right by three small real NIFC-confirmed fires: Moose (US-MT, 125ac, 46.07N/-113.69W), Butterfly (US-MT, 5ac, 46.26N/-113.91W), and Black Bear (US-MT, 5ac, 46.17N/-113.89W). Fire display threshold lowered from 100ac to 1ac after Butterfly/Black Bear were confirmed real but filtered out. Live tracking from here forward: use the tail-number tracker above and enter N520NA for continuous 2s-interval polling.
